label: FX
note: Optical, elemental, and blockbuster VFX overlays.

options.label: Hollywood gasoline fireball & spark explosion
options.rule: a Hollywood gasoline fireball explosion: a massive, rolling orange-and-gold napalm fireball detonates in the background, throwing a roaring shower of bright sparks into the air and bathing the subject's shoulders and hair in intense fiery rim light.

options.label: 360° compressed-air shockwave ring
options.rule: a compressed-air shockwave ring: a visible, translucent spherical ripple of refracted air and radial floor dust expands explosively outward from the subject, whipping hair, fabric and loose debris backward.

options.label: Muzzle-flash strobe & spinning brass shells
options.rule: a gun-fu muzzle-flash and brass-casing storm: strobing orange star-shaped muzzle flashes illuminate the darkened room in sharp bursts while dozens of gleaming golden brass shell casings spin and clatter through the air in slow motion.

options.label: Matrix bullet-time air-ripple trails
options.rule: bullet-time air-ripple trails: spinning copper bullets slice through the air in ultra-slow motion, leaving concentric silver corkscrew shockwave rings suspended across the foreground.

options.label: Backlit plate-glass shatter explosion
options.rule: a backlit plate-glass shatter explosion: a wall of glass bursts outward into thousands of glittering, diamond-like shards that spin and catch the backlight in slow motion around the subject.

options.label: White-hot steel impact spark shower
options.rule: a white-hot steel impact spark shower: blinding cascades of incandescent orange and white metal sparks erupt and rain down across the foreground as if blades or bullets are clashing against steel.

options.label: Super-Saiyan energy aura & levitating rocks
options.rule: a surging plasma energy aura with levitating stones: a roaring, translucent shroud of golden-cyan energy flames upward around the subject's body while cracked floor pebbles and dust lift weightlessly into the air.

options.label: Crackling blue plasma energy beam
options.rule: a crackling plasma energy beam: a blinding sphere of blue-white energy condenses between the subject's hands and fires forward as a roaring cylindrical beam wrapped in spiraling lightning arcs.

options.label: Spiderweb concrete ground-crater fracture
options.rule: a spiderweb ground-crater fracture: the stone or concrete floor beneath the subject cracks open in a jagged radial spiderweb pattern, venting glowing orange fissures and a rising ring of dust.

options.label: High-speed backlit sweat & mist spray
options.rule: a high-shutter-speed backlit impact mist: a dramatic halo of glistening sweat droplets and fine water mist blasts outward from the subject's hair and skin in crisp 1000-fps slow motion.

options.label: Tactical crimson smoke-grenade plume
options.rule: a tactical crimson smoke-grenade plume: thick, velvety clouds of vivid red smoke hiss and billow across the floor and around the subject, pierced by sharp shafts of backlight.

options.label: Spinning fiery dimensional portal ring
options.rule: a spinning fiery portal ring: a circular tear in space ringed with whirling orange sling-ring sparks opens directly behind the subject, revealing a glowing alien vista beyond.

options.label: Nanotech glowing armor materialization
options.rule: a nanotech armor materialization: thousands of glowing hexagonal metallic nano-plates flow rapidly across the subject's skin and lock together with blue energy seams.

options.label: Living glossy black liquid-suit tendrils
options.rule: living glossy black liquid tendrils: viscous, mirror-gloss black symbiote tendrils surge up the subject's arms and torso, webbing together into a sleek living skin.

options.label: Supersonic vapor-cone shockwave
options.rule: a supersonic Prandtl-Glauert vapor cone: a conical white cloud of condensed air pressure blooms around the subject as they accelerate, followed by a radial camera-shake ripple.

options.label: 💨 Warm Breath Fogging Up the Camera Lens Glass
options.rule: close-up breath condensation on the camera lens: as the subject exhales close to the camera, a soft translucent patch of warm moisture fogs the lower glass of the lens and slowly clears.

options.label: 💧 Glistening Water Droplets Beading on the Camera Lens
options.rule: glistening water droplets hits the camera lens glass: a few clear droplets of water bead and slide down the front element of the lens, refracting the warm lights behind.

options.label: 🌹 Slow-Motion Drifting Crimson Rose Petals Through Frame
options.rule: velvety crimson rose petals drift and spiral slowly through the foreground and background air in shallow focus, brushing past bare skin.

options.label: 🍾 Popping Champagne Foam & Sparkling Golden Mist Spray
options.rule: a sparkling champagne spray eruption: fizzing golden champagne arcs through the air in slow motion, catching the light in thousands of glistening droplets.

options.label: ✨ Glistening Sweat Beads & Dewy Skin Specular Shimmer
options.rule: high-specular dewy skin and glistening sweat beads: fine droplets of moisture catch the key light across the collarbone, chest, and shoulders, rolling slowly down the skin with every movement.

options.label: 🌸 Swirling Pink Sakura Cherry Blossom Petals in Breeze
options.rule: delicate pink sakura cherry blossom petals swirl across the frame on a warm breeze, with soft out-of-focus petals passing right in front of the lens.

options.label: ✨ Shimmering Gold Dust Motes & Warm Starburst Bokeh
options.rule: shimmering gold dust motes suspended in sunbeams: tiny specks of golden light drift through the air and bloom into warm circular bokeh orbs.

options.label: 🌈 Crystal Prism Rainbow Edge Refraction & Dreamy Bloom
options.rule: optical crystal prism refraction: the outer edges of the frame split into soft rainbow spectral flares and dreamy double-image reflections while the center subject stays sharp.

options.label: 📼 90s Camcorder CRT Scanlines & Tracking Glitch Bar
options.rule: analog VHS camcorder overlay: subtle horizontal CRT scanlines, warm magnetic tape chroma bleed, and a brief rolling tracking bar across the bottom edge.

options.label: 📸 Red-Carpet Paparazzi Camera Flashbulb Barrage
options.rule: a barrage of rapid white paparazzi camera flashes: crisp bursts of high-key white flash light pop from multiple angles around the subject, casting shifting hard shadows and dazzling specular highlights.

options.label: 🖤 Coiling Living Shadow Tendrils Rising from Floor
options.rule: living shadow tendrils: sleek, smoky-black ribbons of living shadow rise from the floor and coil sinuously around the ankles, thighs, and wrists.

options.label: 💓 Hypnotic Heartbeat Micro-Pulse & Warm Vignette
options.rule: a rhythmic heartbeat optical pulse: on each slow thump, the edges of the frame bloom with a subtle warm vignette and shallow focus breathing locked to the subject's eyes.

options.label: 🌊 Anime2Real: Demon Slayer Water Breathing Dragon & Ukiyo-e Wave Foam on Blade
options.rule: photorealistic Water Breathing sword VFX: every swing of the weapon trails a churning vortex of crystal-clear ocean water and white ukiyo-e wave crests that coils into a roaring translucent water dragon splashing real water droplets across the room.

options.label: 🔥 Anime2Real: Hinokami Sun Breathing Liquid Solar Fire & Ember Trails
options.rule: photorealistic Sun Breathing fire VFX: blazing arcs of white-hot liquid solar flames and swirling orange embers trail from the weapon and hands, casting intense interactive firelight across real skin and walls.

options.label: ⚡ Anime2Real: Thunder Breathing Golden-Cyan Plasma Lightning & Floor Cracks
options.rule: photorealistic Thunder Breathing lightning VFX: jagged bolts of blinding golden-and-cyan plasma electricity crackle around the subject's legs and weapon, spiderwebbing across the floor and leaving glowing ionized trails.

options.label: 🖤 Anime2Real: Cursed Black Flash (Pitch-Black Ink Core + Jagged Crimson Lightning)
options.rule: photorealistic Cursed Black Flash VFX: dense pitch-black spatial distortion energy rimmed with jagged crimson-red lightning crackles around the subject's fists and erupts in a radial black-and-red shockwave on impact.

options.label: 🎨 Mixed-Reality Slop: 2D Cel-Shaded Neon Paint Slashes & Manga Impact Frames in Real Life
options.rule: mixed-reality 2D-on-3D anime slash VFX: vibrant 2D hand-drawn cel-shaded neon paint ribbons, comic speed-lines, and floating manga impact glyphs erupt in 3D space around the photorealistic live-action performer.

options.label: 🌙 Anime2Real: Moon Breathing Glowing Purple-Gold Crescent Blade Storm
options.rule: photorealistic Moon Breathing VFX: dozens of glowing violet-and-gold miniature crescent moon blades orbit the weapon and fan out in a razor-sharp luminescent storm across the room.

options.label: 🖤 Anime2Real: Solo Leveling Shadow Monarch Black-and-Cyan Liquid Shadow Aura
options.rule: photorealistic Shadow Monarch aura VFX: billowing pitch-black shadow smoke rimmed with glowing electric-cyan flames rises from the floor and wraps around the subject's body and glowing blue eyes.

options.label: 🟣 Anime2Real: Red + Blue Orbs Colliding into Hollow Purple Singularity Sphere
options.rule: photorealistic Hollow Purple VFX: a crimson gravity orb and a cobalt-blue vacuum sphere fuse in front of the subject's hands into a blinding violet singularity that warps light and levitates debris.

options.label: 🌸 Anime2Real: Bankai Senbonzakura — Ten Thousand Glowing Razor Sakura Petals
options.rule: photorealistic Bankai petal-storm VFX: a high-velocity vortex of thousands of glowing metallic-pink cherry blossom petals swirls through the air, casting soft pink rim light across the subject.

options.label: 👑 Anime2Real: Conqueror's Haki Thick Crimson-and-Black Lightning Pressure Dome
options.rule: photorealistic Conqueror's Haki VFX: thick, jagged bolts of crimson-and-black lightning and spherical air-pressure shockwaves radiate outward from the subject, cracking the floor and walls.

options.label: ☁️ Anime2Real: Awakening Luminescent White Hair & Floating Steam-Cloud Scarf
options.rule: photorealistic Sun-God Awakening VFX: a ribbon of glowing, weightless white cumulus steam-clouds floats in a halo loop around the subject's shoulders while their hair glows pure luminescent white.

options.label: 👁️ Anime2Real: Inextinguishable Pitch-Black Flames with Violet Heat-Haze
options.rule: photorealistic Amaterasu black-fire VFX: dense, roaring pitch-black flames rimmed with eerie violet heat-shimmer burn across surfaces and weapons.

options.label: 💥 Mixed-Reality Slop: Spider-Verse Ben-Day Halftone Dots & Chromatic Split Frames
options.rule: mixed-reality comic-book pop-art VFX: vibrant Ben-Day halftone dot bursts, RGB chromatic split outlines, and floating 3D comic impact lettering erupt around the live-action subject.

options.label: 🕹️ Mixed-Reality Slop: Arcade Hit-Sparks, Combo Counter & Floating 'K.O.!' Hologram
options.rule: mixed-reality fighting-game HUD VFX: neon pixel hit-sparks, a floating holographic combo counter, and a glowing 'K.O.!' banner erupt in 3D space on impact.

options.label: 🍯 Glistening Stream of Warm Golden Body Oil Pouring Over Skin
options.rule: a continuous glistening ribbon of warm golden body oil pours from above onto bare skin, spreading into a mirror-bright, wet specular sheen.

options.label: 🖐️ Steamed-Up Glass / Mirror Wiped Clear by a Sliding Palm
options.rule: thick white bathroom steam coats the foreground glass or mirror until a bare palm presses and wipes across it, leaving a crystal-clear wet streak.

options.label: 🏮 Floating 3D Neon Kanji Holograms Reflecting in Wet Floor Puddles
options.rule: translucent 3D magenta-and-cyan neon kanji holograms float in the air around the subject and reflect sharply in the wet puddles underfoot.

options.label: 🌸 Anime2Real Senbonzakura — Glowing Pink Cherry-Blossom Blade-Petal Hurricane
options.rule: millions of razor-sharp, bioluminescent pink cherry-blossom blade petals swirl in a high-velocity vortex around the subject, casting soft magenta rim light across skin and slicing through foreground obstacles.

options.label: 🌈 Anime2Real Sandevistan — Neon Prismatic Afterimage Clone Trail on Every Move
options.rule: every rapid movement leaves a glowing neon cyan-and-emerald chromatic afterimage trail of 6 to 8 translucent body silhouettes suspended along the path of motion.

options.label: ☀️ Anime2Real Sun-Breathing — Coiling Solar-Fire Dragon & Golden Ember Halo
options.rule: a roaring, photorealistic 3D dragon of white-hot solar crimson-and-gold fire coils around the subject's weapon and torso, shedding drifting golden embers that illuminate the room.

options.label: 🟣 Anime2Real Shadow Monarch — Pitch-Black Liquid Shadow & Violet Lightning Aura
options.rule: billowing black-and-violet shadow smoke rises from the floor around the subject's boots while electric purple lightning arcs crackle across their shoulders and glowing eyes.

options.label: 🔥 Dragon's Breath Incendiary — Blinding Cone of White-Hot Magnesium Sparks
options.rule: a roaring 15-foot cone of white-hot orange magnesium sparks and incandescent embers erupts across the frame, bouncing off walls and floor in slow motion.

options.label: ✨ Glamour Body Oil — Mirror-Gloss Golden Specular Skin Sheen & Rolling Droplets
options.rule: a rich, mirror-gloss coat of warm golden body oil gleams across bare skin, catching razor-sharp specular highlights and slow-rolling oil droplets on every curve.

options.label: 🥂 Champagne Spray — Effervescent Golden Foam & Suspended Liquid Pearls
options.rule: a pressurized spray of sparkling golden champagne arcs through the air in slow motion, coating bare skin and glittering in thousands of suspended effervescent droplets.

options.label: ♨️ Hot-Spring Onsen Steam — Rising Thermal Mist & Dewy Skin Condensation
options.rule: thick curls of warm white thermal steam rise from the water surface while glistening beads of condensation roll down flushed skin.

options.label: 💥 Mixed-Reality Manga Kanji — Metallic 3D Japanese Sound-Effect Characters Floating on Impact
options.rule: bold, stylized 3D metallic-and-ink Japanese manga sound-effect characters ('ゴゴゴ' / 'ドォン') erupt in mid-air beside the subject on every heavy beat or strike.

options.label: 🌹 Velvet Rose-Petal Storm — Swirling Deep-Crimson Rose Petals Drifting Past Lens
options.rule: hundreds of velvety deep-crimson rose petals drift and swirl through the air in foreground bokeh and settle across the bedsheets and bare skin.

options.label: 💨 Kinetic Shockwave — Expanding Ground Dust Ring & Debris Burst
options.rule: At impact, a flat circular pressure wave explodes radially outward across the ground kicking up dust, leaves, and coat hems in a sharp shockwave.

options.label: 🌧️ Bullet-Time Suspended Raindrops & Hair Strand Micro-Drift
options.rule: As speed ramps abruptly into bullet-time, hundreds of illuminated raindrops freeze suspended in mid-air catching neon rim glints while the camera glides past.

options.label: 🌸 Pink Sakura Wind-Shear Vortex Swirling Around Strikes
options.rule: Every spin kick or blade swing stirs hundreds of sunlit pink cherry blossom petals into a rising aerodynamic spiral around both combatants.

options.label: ⚡ Crimson & Pitch-Black Lightning Arcs Crackling on Impact
options.rule: Razor-jagged scarlet-and-black lightning tendrils crackle wildly outward from knuckle and blade collisions, flashing stark crimson highlights across faces.

options.label: ✨ Rising Golden Ember Ash & Warm Hero Energy Aura
options.rule: Luminous warm golden embers lift steadily upward from the floor around the subject's boots and billowing jacket hems like weightless sparks.

options.label: 💎 Slow-Motion Shattering Safety Glass Diamond Glitter
options.rule: Thousands of glistening faceted safety-glass cubes hang spinning slowly in golden backlight like suspended diamonds.

options.label: 🎀 Weightless Floating Crimson Silk Ribbons Drifting Across Frame
options.rule: Long luminous sheer silk ribbons drift gracefully through foreground and midground air currents curling softly past shoulders.

options.label: 🚨 Sweeping Crimson Security Laser Beams Slicing Haze
options.rule: Razor-thin glowing crimson security laser beams slice diagonally through misty vault air, casting tiny bright red pinpoint dots where beams graze skin or fabric.

options.label: 🫧 Steamy Mirror Fog Clearing Across Palm Swipe Reveal
options.rule: Warm white bath steam coats the mirror borders while a clean hand swipe across the glass opens a crystal-clear reflection frame right on cue.

options.label: 💧 Mirror-Gloss Water & Body Oil Bead Specular Catchlights
options.rule: Hundreds of crisp round clear water and glistening oil droplets cling across curved shoulders, collarbones, and thighs catching warm pinpoint specular sparks.

options.label: ✨ Soft Halation Bloom & Lush Stretched City Light Bokeh
options.rule: Warm dreamy 35mm optical halation blooms gently around lamps and city lights, melting distant streetlamps into large creamy oval bokeh orbs.

options.label: 🔥 Radiant Thermal Air-Warp Distortion Behind Heat / Blast
options.rule: Wavy optical refraction warps the air visibly around glowing hot metal, roaring flame trails, or overcharged energy weapons.

options.label: Fluid High-Speed Slow Motion
options.rule: smooth high-frame-rate slow motion letting water droplets, hair, and sparks hang crisply in mid-air

options.label: Suspended Freeze & Arc
options.rule: mid-air physical climax suspended nearly frozen while the camera sweeps smoothly around floating debris

options.label: Crystal Prism Rainbow Edge Split
options.rule: delicate prismatic spectral rainbow light flares refracting softly along highlight edges

options.label: Poetic Double Exposure Blend
options.rule: ghostly layered double exposure blending silhouette movement smoothly with city lights or foliage

options.label: RGB Digital Glitch Pulse
options.rule: intermittent crisp RGB scanline shifts and digital block displacement on impact beats

options.label: Blazing Flame Aura & Sparks
options.rule: licking crimson-gold flames swirling cleanly around hands or weapons casting bright orange specular bounce

options.label: Crackling Electric Arcs
options.rule: sharp cobalt-violet lightning tendrils snapping across skin, steel, and shadowed walls

options.label: Pressurized Swirling Water Ribbons
options.rule: crystalline arcs of translucent swirling water erupting around movement with backlit spray droplets

options.label: Swirling Sakura Petal Storm
options.rule: hundreds of crisp pink cherry-blossom petals drifting and swirling cleanly through wind and backlight

options.label: Low Rolling Stage Mist
options.rule: dense velvety white low-lying mist pooling smoothly around ankles and furniture legs

options.label: Living Still-Motion Isolate
options.rule: poised near-still subject framing while hair tips, steam, or curtain edges ripple softly

options.label: Kinetic Pixel-Melt Transition
options.rule: fluid motion-vector smear carrying movement smoothly from one silhouette into the next

options.rule: faceted crystalline prism reflections multiplying warm light highlights cleanly along frame borders

options.rule: crisp emerald-phosphor low-light surveillance sheen with glowing eyeshine and subtle tube grain

options.label: Shifting Mosaic Particle Scatter
options.rule: crisp geometric pixel blocks dissolving smoothly along motion edges into floating embers

options.label: Mapped Light & Shadow Patterns
options.rule: vibrant cinematic film or floral patterns projected cleanly across bare shoulders and walls

options.label: Luminous Volumetric Laser Sweep
options.rule: thin glowing horizontal laser scanline sweeping cleanly top-to-bottom across silhouettes

options.label: Fluid Slit-Scan Time Ribbon
options.rule: hypnotic flowing horizontal light ribbons stretching behind rhythmic movement

options.label: False-Color Heat Signature Map
options.rule: vivid indigo-to-amber-white thermal heat gradient tracing warm skin against cool air

options.rule: crisp 35mm flash pop with playful subtle parallax depth shift

options.label: Translucent Cyan Structural Radiograph
options.rule: clean glowing blue-white translucent medical-art overlay gliding smoothly across silhouette edges

options.label: Stroboscopic Cyclical Cadence
options.rule: crisp stroboscopic flash accents carving rhythmic pose phases cleanly across dark studio air

options.label: 🌀 Altered-State Hue Afterimage & Motion Smear Trail
options.rule: dreamlike perceptual smear leaving soft translucent color afterimages trailing gracefully behind turning heads and moving hands

options.label: 📏 Forced-Perspective Scale Play (Foreground Giant / Background Tiny)
options.rule: clever in-camera forced-perspective depth staging placing a near-lens hand or prop at towering scale beside a distant full figure aligned on the same tabletop plane

options.label: 🚪 Prop / Mirror Wormhole Portal Transition
options.rule: seamless spatial portal effect where an ordinary mirror, cabinet door, or bag opens cleanly directly into a contrasting distant location

options.rule: tactile 3D photogrammetry scan aesthetic revealing faceted polygon surface micro-glints and crisp captured texture facets as the camera orbits smoothly

options.rule: smoothly widening letterbox side mattes opening from tight claustrophobic framing into full panoramic horizontal space as the beat crescendos

options.label: 🪞 Arm's-Length Selfie Twin Double-Take
options.rule: playful arm's-length wide-angle front-camera framing placing identical twin personas side by side reacting together in crisp candid phone clarity

options.label: 🏷️ Die-Cut Sticker Peel World Reveal
options.rule: glossy die-cut vinyl sticker edge curling smoothly off the frame corner with crisp adhesive sheen to reveal an active live scene underneath

options.label: 🌸 Floating Cherry Blossom Petals & Warm Wind Drift
options.rule: soft pink cherry-blossom petals drifting naturally across the foreground and midground in warm air currents, catching crisp specular highlights against shallow depth of field

options.label: 🎉 Stage Confetti & Metallic Foil Sparkle Drift
options.rule: iridescent metallic foil confetti and delicate stage sparkle drifting slowly down through bright concert spotlights, catching brilliant highlights around the dancing subject

options.label: 🎞️ Horizontal Anamorphic Amber-Blue Streak Lens Flare
options.rule: authentic anamorphic cinema lens flare casting a subtle horizontal warm-amber and cyan optical streak across highlights whenever practical bulbs or headlights graze the glass

options.label: ⚡ Subtle Step-Printed Kinetic Motion Trail (90s Arthouse)
options.rule: delicate Wong Kar-wai style step-printed shutter drag creating poetic dreamy motion trails behind rapid hand gestures and turning hair while keeping eyes clear

options.label: ✨ Illuminated Golden Dust Motes Floating in Window Sunbeam
options.rule: thousands of microscopic warm golden dust motes floating lazily through slanted sunlight beams, adding rich atmospheric depth to indoor movement

options.label: 💧 Natural Raindrops & Condensation Beads on Camera Lens Edge
options.rule: occasional fine raindrops and warm edge condensation beading softly near the periphery of the camera lens glass, refracting distant neon bokeh into glowing orbs
